description: One row per document under examples/negatives/. Each document is a refused instance: it violates exactly one constraint of the schema the row names, and every other constraint of that schema holds, so a validator that reports a violation at a second instance location is reporting a defect in the document rather than in the constraint under test. file is the document's name in this directory; schema is the path of the schema the document is validated against, relative to the root of this repository; constraint is the JSON Schema keyword that refuses the document; instance_path is the JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) of the value the constraint refuses, which is the empty string when the value is the whole document; violates says in one sentence what the document does wrong. Every document in this directory has exactly one row here, and every row names a document that is present.

negatives.violates: the analyzer object omits conformance, so the report records no conformance pass
the component identifier omits the prefix that keeps two analyzers from colliding
a declared configuration carries the members of both shapes, a platform and a project, and an entry is one shape or the other
the report names no configuration, so no finding could name one it holds in
the describe document writes conformance as null, where an analyzer that records no conformance run omits the member
the describe document carries a target, a member the closed key list does not declare
the evaluation reports the dead state and carries no pending finding
the evaluation reports the live state and still carries a pending finding
DS1101 carries an empty details and states no narrower visibility
DS1001 carries narrower_visibility, which only the visibility-narrowing codes carry
a reported finding names an exemption class, which only a retained-symbol listing does
the symbol kind is a word the closed vocabulary does not carry
a finding about a configured declaration carries a liveness relation, which only a finding about a declaration carries
a finding about a configured root carries a liveness relation, which only a finding about a declaration carries
a finding about a declared cross-language edge carries a liveness relation, which only a finding about a declaration carries
a finding about a parameter carries a liveness relation, which only a finding about a declaration carries
the message ends with a full stop, so a consumer cannot append a clause to it
a position column is zero, and a column is counted from one
a configuration the analysis ran carries the members of both shapes, a platform and a project, and an entry is one shape or the other
the applied convention row's name is not lowercase words joined by hyphens, so the configuration cannot spell it to disable the row
the note's kind is outside the closed set of notes the report carries
the type-error skip names line 0, and lines are counted from 1
the entry counts no unanswered question, and a configuration whose every question was answered has no entry
the envelope carries a member the schema does not declare
a module the document places among the consumers declares the target's role, so the document contradicts itself about which module the analysis reports on
the scope spells a declared key in another case, and the closed key list compares keys as bytes, so the spelling names no declared key
the scope names consumers and no target, so the analysis has nothing to report on
the target's name is empty, which names no module; a document that leaves the name to the load omits the member
the target's name is null rather than a string; a document that leaves the name to the load omits the member
the target's path is empty, so it names no directory to load
the scope carries a member the closed key list does not declare
the workspace member is a Boolean rather than the path of a workspace file
a stale-suppression record names another code, and the kind is fixed
the target root is an absolute path, which two machines would not write alike
a registration entry carries a member none of the three declaration shapes declares, so it names no declaration
a lifecycle contract names its framework by a name, and a contract states its framework by the declarations that make a class a component
a lifecycle contract names no declaration and no base class that makes a class a component, so it retains nothing
a serializer entry carries a member none of the three declaration shapes declares, so it names no declaration
